title: Yosemite National Park
summary: Yosemite National Park lies in California's Sierra Nevada and is known for granite relief shaped by glaciation, including hanging valleys, domes, waterfalls and giant sequoia groves. Congress designated it a national park in 1890, and it was later inscribed as a World Heritage site in 1984.
